# mockingbird_workspace (Data Source)

Reads a workspace the caller has a role in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mockingbird_workspace" "current" {}

output "my_role" {
  value = data.mockingbird_workspace.current.role
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Workspace name. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `id` (String) The workspace name.
- `role` (String) The caller's role in the workspace (`viewer`, `editor`, `admin` or `owner`); null for a sysadmin without one.
